typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		Id as string,
		VersionData as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: false,
	validateSchema: true,
	ignoreNoFilesFound: false,
	wildcardPaths:['salesforce/version_data.csv']) ~> source1
source1 derive(VersionData = toString(unhex(ltrim(VersionData,'0x')))) ~> DerivedColumn1
DerivedColumn1 sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	partitionFileNames:['version_data.csv'],
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> sink1
